title: antennaria howellii var. athabascensis
intro: Antennaria howellii var. athabascensis, commonly known as Athabasca yarrow, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae, characterized by its small, white or pale pink flowers and lance-shaped leaves. This plant has been traditionally used for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing due to its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Athabasca yarrow include its ability to soothe skin irritations and reduce fever. Bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpene lactones, which have been found to exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
